title: The Oak Podcast
author: Oak
description: Welcome to The Oak Podcast - conversations about the mountains, the people who spend their lives in them, and the communities built around them. We sit down with mountain guides, athletes, climbers, skiers, runners, creators and everyday mountain people to hear their stories, learn from their experiences, and talk about what really matters in the mountains. Expect honest conversations, memorable adventures, hard-earned lessons, useful insights and plenty of stories from life outside. Whether you're just getting started or have spent years in the mountains, each episode is here to inspire you to get out, learn more, meet people and keep progressing.
